question: Which energy of the wind does a windmill use?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Kinetic energy.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Wind turbines change the **kinetic energy** in the wind into mechanical power. 
 
• Kinetic energy is **a form of energy that an object or a particle has by reason of its motion**. 
 
• Any** object in motion** is using kinetic energy.
 
• The units of kinetic energy are **mass times the square of the speed**, or kg · m 2 /s 2 kg · m 2 /s 2 .
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d955ef494cd3a89fef12f1d49b9351ba17d662e9ba96f986590aecbdfc2c74f3.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Thermal energy mentions to **the movement of molecules inside an object or substance**.
 
• Heat is **the form of energy that is transferred between systems or objects with unlike temperatures.**
 
• Hydroelectric energy is a form of sustainable energy that uses the power of moving water to generate electricity.​
